evidence.title: OpenUsage - AI Limits Tracker for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and more

name: OpenUsage
summary: macOS menu bar app tracking AI coding subscription limits and spend across 11 providers.
description: Native macOS 15+ menu bar app that reads the credentials already on your Mac to show session and weekly limits, pace warnings and cost history for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Grok and other AI providers. Status lines, editors and agents can read the numbers through a local API or the openusage command; up to two metrics per provider can be pinned. Free and open source.
contains: tracks 11 AI providers incl. Claude, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Grok, Copilot, Ollama, OpenRouter
session and weekly limits with pace markers and burn warnings
spend for today, yesterday or 30 days
local API on localhost:6736 and an openusage CLI command
no login; multiple accounts synced over iCloud
